title: The result-intake elements of rwb-partner are not fixed by any source: the 409 and 404 problem texts, the multipart bound, the decision code and version the local record names, the activity and signal names, and the retention of the request
source: Legacy RWB-E6-033 sections 1, 7, 12, 14 and 16; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A2.5, A2.5.3.1 and A2.5.4; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T3.1, T3.2, T6.1 and T-A.2; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 8 and 12; Event and Messaging Design v4 sheet Events rows EV-20 and EV-21; Template and Rules v1 R7.2, R7.3 and R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 5 Exception paths X1; 7 Acceptance criteria AC2 to AC6; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.5; 14 Validation and messages; 15 Screens and states
description: Five elements the app slice needs are absent from every source. (1) The legacy message table carries MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003 only; no source gives the text or a message ID for the 409 refusal of a closed instruction or the 404 of a foreign firm, so the story publishes the status with no message ID. (2) The multipart bound of API-S9-005 is not stated; T-A.2 names the request as 'Multipart: result, files' and nothing more. (3) The legacy AC1 writes 'the result to the decision log with the rule version', but no source names the decision code of the result intake or the rule whose version the record carries; the legacy data table names rule_row (DF-REF-001 to DF-REF-015) without a rule ID. (4) The instruction workflow name is the one ownership row (InstructionWorkflow); the activity and signal names are in no source. (5) The retention of a partner instruction and its result, and of the result documents held by rwb-document, is not stated.
evidence: FSD S9 A2.5.4 lists AC-S9-005-01 with the generic Given 'The data and rules it needs are in place'; TSD S9 T-A.2 API-S9-005 lists errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 503 with no message per status; the legacy validation table has three rows; the context pack names one workflow and no activity; no data retention rule appears in the S9 FSD, the TSD or the Program BRD.
area: S9 rwb-partner; partner result intake; decision record; messages
owner_role: Solution architect with the partner service owner
proposed: Keep the three legacy message IDs for their own triggers, publish the 409, 404, 415 and 422 bodies as RFC 9457 problems with a status and a detail and no message ID, fix the multipart bound and the two activity names in the app slice at the contract freeze, and take the decision code and the version in force from the parameters contract of rwb-case at their version; confirm the retention with the records owner.

title: The published shapes of the partner result contract are not fixed by any source: the multipart schema, the PartnerInstruction and InstructionPage element names, the event payload beyond three fields, the partner gateway profile and the error bodies
source: Legacy RWB-E6-033 sections 7 and 12; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A2.5; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T3.1, T3.2, T6.1, T-A.1 and T-A.2; API Specification v4; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 8; Event and Messaging Design v4 sheet Events EV-21; Template and Rules v1 R4, R7.2 and R9
section: 3 Preconditions; 5 Exception paths X6; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1, AC3 and AC4; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.3; 12.8; 13 Solution plan
description: Six elements of the two published operations are absent from every source. (1) The multipart part names and their media types: T-A.2 says 'Multipart: result, files' and nothing more. (2) The element names of PartnerInstruction and InstructionPage: T3.1 gives the table columns DF-PRT-008 to DF-PRT-016 and T-A.2 gives the entity names only. (3) The event payload beyond instructionId, result and documents; EV-21 lists those three and the design states that from Epic 3 the topics carry CloudEvents, but no schema exists. (4) The treatment of the case ID as key and subject: EV-21 carries no case ID, so the routing element the rwb-case consumer needs is not in the source. (5) The partner gateway FAPI 2.0 profile, its client registration and the assertion it forwards to the service. (6) The 409, 415 and 422 problem bodies and their message IDs, and the retention of the resource.
evidence: TSD S9 T-A.2 API-S9-005 and API-S9-003 give purpose, request, response, errors, authorization and idempotency with no schema; T3.1 lists columns not element names; Event and Messaging Design v4 row EV-21 lists three payload elements and gives the case and workflow as the consumer; Architecture v5 slide 8 shows the partner gateway (FAPI 2.0 to S9) with no profile detail; no OpenAPI fragment for the two operations exists in the API Specification v4 extract.
area: S9 rwb-partner; contract; API and event schema
owner_role: Solution architect with the platform edge owner
proposed: Publish the two schemas from the TSD columns, keep the three EV-21 payload elements and add the case ID as key and ce_subject with the assumption recorded, publish the multipart part names at the contract freeze, and take the partner gateway profile from the edge story when it is published.
